plan.summary: BRO-5243 (h): rename 8 WSJ review files from wsj--charles-isherwood.json to wsj--terry-teachout.json. All 8 hold Teachout's signed reviews (2019-2021, before Isherwood joined WSJ). The live show pages already say Teachout, but Isherwood's critic page lists 4 of them and the verifier judges them against Isherwood. Then re-verify 3 stale verdicts.
steps: rename 8 Isherwood-named files to the Teachout file name
